title: Keep plain login neutral regardless of remembered company
public_pr_body:
Plain `/login` now always uses Tolra's neutral design. Remembered cookies and legacy localStorage cannot restore company branding; explicit `?org=` links and company subdomains retain their existing server-side branding.

The app shell no longer calls the remember route, which remains available for compatibility. Sign-in, MFA, redirects and session behavior are unchanged.

Validation: all 5,028 unit tests passed; typecheck and lint passed; Chromium verified neutral login after hydration with both remembered cookie and legacy storage set. The updated five-test browser file was collected. The backend browser suite, including the real-company query-link test, was not run because no disposable Supabase backend is available; no migrations or SQL were applied.
